title: Modulators
description: Continuous atmospheric phenomena layered on top of the Almanac's base directive. Each record binds a weather signal (or a composite of signals) to a curve that produces a 0..1 strength, then applies a bundle of deltas to directive fields. Authored in Meteorologist's Modulators tab, published as public/clouds/modulators.json, composed by src/lib/almanac-eval.js after the Almanac selects the base directive. Doctrine: feedback_absence_means_inherit_in_authored_blocks — absent delta fields leave the base directive untouched.

modulators.description: Each modulator independently evaluates a strength from the live signals payload and applies its deltas. Composition is multiplicative for scalar scales, sum-and-clamp for tintToward amounts, last-wins for color hex overrides.

rampMinutes.description: Author's note on intended ramp; the actual smoothing happens via AtmosphereDirectiveDriver's per-frame lerp toward the resolved directive. Surfaced in the editor so the operator can communicate intent and tune ramp visually in a future revision.

between.description: Inclusive numeric range. 1 if lo<=value<=hi, else 0. Used for continuous-range membership where 'in' (discrete-set membership) would be inappropriate.

deltas.description: Map of directive dot-paths (e.g. 'sun.tint', 'lightDome.ambientFloor', 'wind.scale') to delta records. Absent paths leave the base directive untouched.

oneOf.description: Color hex lerp. At strength=1 the directive field becomes 'to'. Overrides the base value (last-wins if multiple modulators target the same color field).
Scalar multiplier. At strength=s the directive field is multiplied by mix(scale[0], scale[1], s). Composes multiplicatively with other scale deltas on the same field.
Color tint that lerps the current field value toward tintToward by mix(amount[0], amount[1], strength). Composes additively (amounts sum-and-clamp).
Direct scalar range [lo, hi]. Value becomes mix(lo, hi, strength). Composes by sum-and-clamp on the per-modulator output deltas.
